
{{alias}}( lambda )
    Returns the standard deviation of a Planck distribution with shape
    parameter `lambda`.

    If `lambda < 0`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    lambda: number
        Shape parameter.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Standard deviation.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 0.1 )
    ~9.9958
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.5 )
    ~0.6080

    See Also
    --------
